name: Budget Review Meeting
description: Capture credit union budget review discussions including financial performance, variance analysis, forecasts, and spending decisions.

sections.title: Meeting Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize the purpose of the meeting — whether it is an annual budget approval, mid-year review, monthly variance review, or departmental budget discussion — and the time period being reviewed.

sections.title: Attendees
sections.instruction: List all attendees and their roles (e.g., CFO, department heads, board treasurer, budget analyst).

sections.title: Financial Performance Summary
sections.instruction: Summarize the overall financial performance discussed — income, expenses, net income, asset growth, loan volume, or other key metrics reviewed against budget.

sections.title: Budget vs. Actual Variances
sections.instruction: Capture the key budget variances reviewed, explanations provided, and whether variances are expected to persist.

sections.title: Departmental Highlights
sections.instruction: Summarize any department-specific budget discussions, notable over or under-spending, and context provided by department heads.

sections.title: Forecast & Outlook
sections.instruction: Summarize any updated forecasts, projections, or outlook adjustments discussed for the remainder of the fiscal year or future periods.

sections.title: Decisions & Approvals
sections.instruction: List any budget adjustments, reallocation requests, new spending approvals, or freezes that were decided during the meeting.

sections.title: Action Items & Follow-Up
sections.instruction: List follow-up tasks such as revised projections to submit, additional analysis requested, or approvals pending. Include owners and deadlines.
